findings.reason: without an arm each the plan's own stated fixes are untestable, and the negative control it does declare ("removes the quiet-period check") falsifies only the two-minute arm, leaving the day-old exclusion free to regress silently.
findings.text: the body says the re-landing "adds arms for each defect", but the done-when still carries only the pre-revert arms (eleven minutes, two minutes, in flight, notes) plus a quiet-period negative control: there is no arm for the one-day upper bound (defect 1), none for composing under the plan's own authoring session (defect 2), and none for batching a pass's answers into one commit (defect 3), so two of the three repairs and half of the third are unmeasured

findings.reason: as written the node must either invent a durable plan-to-session record (a write path and a scope the section does not declare) or ship the reverted behaviour again, so the plan would send it down a path it has not costed.
